title: A Few More Axes
description: There's no such thing as too much Axes!
body:
# A Whole Lotta Axes

This is the A Few More Axes Mod, beind a sequel to the Just a Few Pickaxes mod. I've come a long way already and am proud to show it! No updates are promised. This mod is not live-service.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/p90PEewDtwY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# What's in it?

- Stripped Wooden Axe: A worse but brighter Wooden Axe (in block form, too)!
- Saxepling: Where a Axe meets replanting their enemy.
- Iron Hatchet: A double-sided blast to the past, seeming like a battle axe.
- Taxe: When you own less than 50% of an Axe, and the rest goes to... someone?
- Condensed Axe: When everything doubles in size, it's really... _explosive_. 
- Condensedered Axe: When everything doubles again, it's really... gone. And tiny.
- Potato Axe: Give you the Potato Effect, spawning tons of potato and making you lose all balance. Potion works on nearly all mobs.
- An Actual Fire Axe: Is your fire animation not loading? Have no fear, this axe is fire! Honestly! Can make floating fake fire.
- Pigaxe: With the essence of the pigs, you can make EVERYTHING a pig. Everything. Do not hit the Ender Dragon.
- Lightning Axe: Strikes you down with tons of propulsion.
- John Cenaxe: With Air (that floating you up), you can become INVISIBLE, like the man himself!
- Sacrifical Item Tributation Device: Small trading station. Lets you create Minecraft and other creative juices.
- Flickering Axe: STRONG. No attack speed.
- dAkIMgon AXe4F: Made by a four-year-old, most likely. Brings you to a whole new dimesion.
- Defying Axe: Defy gravity by flying in Survival mode*! (*up to y=100)
- Removed Herobrine Axe
  
## Credits

Thanks to [EddieR5](https://modrinth.com/user/EddieR5) for the idea for the John Cenaxe.
